title: Frag4 / PHercParis1Fr39: first exploratory ink evaluation of checkpoint A
status_before_labels: PHercParis1Fr39_54keV_inklabels.png not downloaded when this file was committed
label_of_results: exploratory; direct exclusion from A's training probable, not attested

regions.rule: ROIs 2 and 5 of phase11_z_frag4.py (1024 x 1024 px at 2.215 um, centred on frozen geometric patches 2 and 5)
regions.support: published mask eroded by 16 px and Hann weight >= 25 % of maximum

intensity.primary: W2 moment matching, docs/validation/phase11-window.json (mean 26401.6, std 7416.5 uint16 -> 0.379, 0.148)

labels.resampling: same grid mapping as the CT input (nominal 3.24 -> 2.215 um), nearest neighbour

registration_tolerance.rule: the larger of the upper-crack and pooled tolerances (conservative)
registration_tolerance.use: pixels closer than the tolerance to a label edge are excluded from pixel metrics; boundary metrics use this distance

metrics.intervals: block bootstrap, 64 x 64 blocks, 499 draws, seed 208

hypotheses.H1: PR-AUC(Z_in) > PR-AUC(Z_out) in both ROIs, primary window
hypotheses.H2: PR-AUC(Z_in) exceeds the positive-class prevalence (chance level) by more than its block-bootstrap 95 % half-width in both ROIs

not_allowed_after_labels: changing ROIs, window, tolerance, thresholds or depth orders
selecting the better order and reporting only it
